---
title: "Measurement sources"
date: 2026-08-22
abstract: >
  The main public sources used by the Spinorama database and further reading
  about loudspeaker measurements.
---

Spinorama combines measurements from several sources. Each source has its own
equipment, calibration, file format, and editorial practices. The source and
quality fields on a speaker page should always be read together with the
graphs.

## Independent and research sources

- [Audio Science Review](https://www.audiosciencereview.com/) publishes many
  loudspeaker measurements and explains its measurement process in its review
  pages. See [how to support ASR](https://www.audiosciencereview.com/forum/index.php?threads/how-to-support-audio-science-review.8150/).
- [Erin's Audio Corner](https://www.erinsaudiocorner.com/) publishes loudspeaker
  reviews and measurements, with additional explanations on its
  [YouTube channel](https://youtube.com/c/ErinsAudioCorner). See its
  [contribution page](https://www.erinsaudiocorner.com/contribute/).
- [Princeton 3D3A](https://www.princeton.edu/3D3A/) provides a research database
  of loudspeaker polar measurements. Its [database manual](https://www.princeton.edu/3D3A/Manuals/3D3A_Directivity_Database.pdf)
  documents the measurement conventions.
- [speakerdata2034](https://speakerdata2034.blogspot.com/) is an index of
  Spinorama data from multiple sources. Its [measurement index](https://speakerdata2034.blogspot.com/2019/03/all-spinorama-data-index.html)
  is useful when looking for an original review or project.

## Manufacturer and vendor data

Some manufacturers publish GLL files. GLL is a loudspeaker data format
developed by [AFMG](https://www.afmg.eu/en/gll-loudspeaker-file-format), often
used for professional, touring, and installed-sound products. Vendor data can
be useful, but check whether it is smoothed, simulated, or measured, and record
that information in the metadata.

The database includes data from, among others:

Alcons Audio, AsciLab, Audio First Designs, Axiom, Biamp, Coda, d&b
Technik, DAS, Danley, FBT, Fulcrum Acoustics, Genelec, Highlite, Idea, JBL,
K-Array, KME Sound, KV2 Audio, Kling Freitag, LD Systems, Martin Audio, Meyer
Sound, Neumann, Nexo, Presonus, QSC, RCF, SE Audiotechnik, Seeburg, Sigberg
Audio, Soundvision, Turbosound, Wharfedale Pro, and Yamaha.

This list is not a claim that every product from a listed organization has been
measured or that all measurements have the same quality. Use the individual
measurement's origin and quality metadata as the source of truth.

## Adding a source

If you have original measurement files, preserve them in the repository's
measurement layout and record the origin, format, quality, and any review URL
with the [metadata manager](03_metadata.qmd). If you only have a graph image,
use the [digitization guide](03_digitalisation.qmd). Do not redistribute
copyrighted source files without permission.
